metrics.thread_name: [Audit] AUDIT charter use case scope + PR #29 + draft-csoai-audit-use-case-00
metrics.core_debate: Post-hoc accountability vs enforcement/admission accountability — Henri's view is BOTH in scope, but refusal/decline records are a different shape that needs explicit acknowledgement. Without it, audit data models can't separate 'stopped at boundary' from 'no record exists'.
metrics.henri_position: Audit data models must include records of non-events (refusals, timeouts, no-response). PR #29 alone is incomplete without issue #24 point 2 carried alongside. Counter-based streams need time anchors; deployed deployments split authorization + execution into two boundary identities.
metrics.parisa_position: Likely post-hoc accountability is primary scope; she asked the WG to clarify. Notes enforcement/admission requires defining action boundaries for non-deterministic agents and admission unit lifecycle management.
metrics.our_position_implication: CSOAI's existing audit-use-case draft covers the 'something happened' shape. It does NOT yet cover the 'something was declined' shape. Henri's correction strengthens the WG if adopted — and our draft benefits by referencing that property.
